title: Work permit for foreigners
question: Do I need a work permit to work in Poland as a foreigner?
short_answer: Depends on your nationality. EU/EEA citizens work freely. Non-EU citizens usually need a permit.
conditions: EU/EEA citizens: no work permit required, may work freely
Ukrainian citizens: temporary protection holders may work without a permit
Other non-EU: work permit (zezwolenie na pracę) required
Permit types: A, B, C, D, E, S (seasonal) — depends on job type and duration
Work permit type A is most common — employer applies on behalf of employee
Must have a valid visa or residence permit that allows work
exceptions: Persons with long-term residence permit (zezwolenie na pobyt stały)
penalties: Employee: fine 20–5000 PLN for working without proper permit
Employer: fine 1000–50000 PLN for employing illegal workers
Deportation possible for repeated or serious violations

legal_basis.act: Ustawa o promocji zatrudnienia i instytucjach rynku pracy
